title_sq: Tek "Lion Residences 2", Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Siperfaqe Te Bollshme Dhe Planimetri Perfekte!!!
description_sq: Ne Rrugen Dritan Hoxha, tek "Lion Residences 2", shitet super apartament 2+1 !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 17-te banim te nje kompleksi te ri ne faze ndertimi. Lion Residence 2 eshte nje projekt multifunksional shume afer qendres se qytetit me nje fasade teresisht ekologjike dhe te gjelberuar. Pozicionimi i kompleksit prane rruges kryesore e ben lehtesisht te aksesueshem dhe te pershtatshem si per investim ashtu edhe per banim. Zona ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme. Apartamenti ka orientim Jug Perendim cka i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate pjeses me te madhe te dites. Organizimi i brendshem eshte si me poshte: salloni i ndenjes i lidhur me kendin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dhoma matrimoniale me dalje ne ballkon, nje dhome gjumi tjeter dhe dy tualete.
title_en: At "Lion Residences 2", 2+1 Apartment For Sale, With Ample Area And Perfect Layout!!!
description_en: On Dritan Hoxha Street, at "Lion Residences 2", super apartment 2+1 for sale!! The apartment is located on the 17th residential floor of a new complex under construction. Lion Residence 2 is a multifunctional project very close to the city center with a completely ecological and green facade. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services. The apartment has a South-West orientation, which allows natural light during most of the day. The internal organization is as follows: the living room connected to the kitchen corner and with exit to the balcony, matrimonial room with exit to the balcony, another bedroom and two toilets.
